title: Craftable Tridents_
description: It is a mod which helps you to craft Tridents
body:
Craftable Tridents is a lightweight Minecraft mod that adds the ability to craft tridents using vanilla materials. No more relying on drowned mobs for this powerful weapon!

Features:
New Crafting Recipe: Create tridents using a balanced recipe with easily obtainable resources.
Fully Compatible with other mods: Seamlessly integrates into modded gameplay.
Survival and Adventure-friendly: Perfect for players who want a reliable way to obtain tridents without farming mobs.
This mod keeps your game close to vanilla while adding a convenient, lore-friendly method to craft one of the game's rarest weapons.
